facts.fact: The Home Affairs Minister confirmed in the National Assembly on 11 February 2026 a shortage of the paper to print birth certificates and of other consumables at the Registrar General's Department, the state printer Fidelity being unpaid; an MP said offices had gone up to two months without the paper, and the Treasury gave no date for payment.
facts.system: Registrar General's Department birth and death registration

systems.system: Registrar General's Department birth and death registration
systems.owner: Registrar General's Department, Ministry of Home Affairs and Cultural Heritage; funded through the Treasury

note: The event is a funding shortfall for certificate paper and receipt books in the registrar's own service, not an event in a digital system; the document says nothing of how the record is made, and the parent may prefer to drop the last12 fact on that ground.
